frozen: before any method run on the corpus (see git history: oracle freeze commit)

A.description: Deterministic document baseline: ID/cross-reference retrieval over the rendered spec
A.seeds: ids of nodes in node operations; for edge operations both endpoints are emitted as targets (depth 0) and are not expanded

A2.description: Sensitivity condition, separately reported: method A with hops = 2

B.description: GraphADLC.propose(delta) with no evidence_refs (pruning cannot fire)

C.description: GraphADLC.propose(delta) with evidence_refs = every evidence record available in the scenario

normalization.artifact_collapse: artifact target -> the component with a realized_by edge to it in the scenario's pre-change graph
normalization.excluded_targets: nodes directly modified by node operations (after artifact collapse); counted separately

scoring.unknown_handling: excluded from judged universe; best/worst-case sensitivity reported
